title.narrative: Rural Primary Health Services Delivery Project

description.narrative: The project will strengthen rural health systems in selected areas by expanding the coverage and improving the quality of primary health care in partnership with state and other service providers. It will build on Asian Development Bank experience in strengthening health service delivery in rural areas of PNG. The project will cover two districts in each of the following eight provinces: Eastern Highlands, East Sepik, Enga, Milne Bay, Western Highlands, West New Britain, Morobe, and the Autonomous Region of Bougainville.

Progress Toward Outcome: All contracts for civil works and provision of medical equipment have been awarded. Civil works have now been fully delivered in Western Highlands, Milne Bay, West New Britain, Eastern Highlands, Western and East Sepik Provinces, and the Autonomous Region of Bougainville. 31 community health posts (CHP), 2 health centers and 1 district hospital have been completed and turned over to the respective provincial health authorities. The final civil works projects at Laiagam District Hospital and at the Tent Siti Urban Clinic in Lae reached practical completion in May 2022 and certificates of completion have been received from the respective building boards.
